title: Five AI models: alone or with help

design.question: Can a model solve more when it is given the helper ideas (lemmas) a target needs?
design.compare: each model alone, and with the helper ideas each target needs
design.fixed: the 8 posted targets, 2 attempts each, up to 3 repairs, reasoning effort high, grind banned
design.measure: targets solved with help but never alone

answer: With help, 3 of 5 models solved targets they never solved alone (gpt-5.6-terra, gemini-3.8-flash, deepseek-v4.1-flash). claude-opus-5.5 and claude-sonnet-5.5 solved everything alone.
caveats: The helper ideas were given, not found: this measures how much they help, not whether a model would think of them.
Only a few attempts per target: the rates are rough.
